title: Pentagon Releases Eighth Batch Of Declassified UFO Files
excerpt: Trump launched the declassification initiative in February, directing officials to make government UFO records available to the public.
content:
The US Department of War released its eighth batch of declassified Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) records on Friday, November 20, featuring three videos and approximately 40 documents under President Donald Trump’s transparency initiative.

Among the records is a 1953 account by Lockheed chief engineer Clarence “Kelly” Johnson, who reported seeing a dark blue flying saucer and other unidentified objects near his California ranch.

💡

The release also includes the previously unacknowledged “Ten Month Report,” a 538-page dossier prepared by Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies documenting research at Utah’s Skinwalker Ranch, including plans for an underground research vault.

Trump launched the declassification initiative in February, directing officials to make government UFO records available to the public. The Department of War is reviewing millions of historical documents and plans to release additional records on a rolling basis.
